_extraction_flags.notes: Excellent O-ISAC paper! RoF-based ISAC with LFM carrier for distributed fiber sensing + Ka-band mmW communication. IEEE JLT 2025.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig.1: CDM modulation scheme. Fig.3: RoF-ISAC conceptual diagram. Fig.4: Full experimental setup. Fig.5-6: Sensing results (φ-OTDR, RVS, PSD). Fig.9-12: Comm BER results. Note: visual_analysis.txt appears to be for a different paper (VLC positioning) - using paper text instead.
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: LFM carrier-based RoF-ISAC. LFM carrier serves dual purpose: (1) sensing probe for φ-OTDR distributed sensing, (2) beat tone for RoF mmW signal generation. Single laser for both functions. Coherent Driver Module (CDM) at quadrature bias for I/Q modulation. Full-duplex: sensing backscatter + forward communication.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Sensing: φ-OTDR with 28 pε/√Hz strain resolution, 10 m spatial resolution, 10 km range, 50 MHz LFM BW. Comm: 1.6 GBaud 16-QAM at 28 GHz Ka-band, 10 km fiber + 1 m wireless. PCS and pre-compensation for nonlinear mitigation.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Contribution: Ultra-simple RoF-ISAC architecture. LFM carrier dual-use. Single laser. CDM for I/Q upconversion. First RoF+DAS coexistence. Gap: Limited wireless range (1 m demo), sensing resolution limited by LFM BW.

bibliographic.title: Coexistence of Distributed Sensing and Ultra-Simple Coherent RoF Based Front-Haul for Radio Access Network
bibliographic.authors: Maoqi Liu, Jingchuan Wang, Chen Liu, Changyuan Yu, Chao Lu

application.scenario_description: Radio Access Network (RAN) front-haul with coexistence of distributed fiber sensing (DAS) and mmW radio-over-fiber communication.

key_contribution.key_contribution: Ultra-simple RoF-ISAC system using LFM carrier for both distributed sensing and mmW communication. Single laser architecture with CDM for I/Q modulation.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Previous RoF-ISAC required separate branches for sensing and communication signals. This integrates them via dual-use LFM carrier.

transmitter.notes: NKT E15 narrow-linewidth laser. LFM carrier: 400 MHz start, 50 MHz BW. 1.6 GBaud 16-QAM upconverted to 28 GHz IF. CDM at quadrature bias.

receiver.notes: Sensing: ICR (Neophotonic class 40) + matched filter (φ-OTDR). Comm: PD + IQ mixer + RTO.

integration.notes: Single laser for both sensing (backscatter) and comm (forward). LFM carrier dual-use. CDM for I/Q upconversion. PBS for polarization diversity.

waveform.notes: LFM carrier (50 MHz BW) is the sensing probe AND the beat tone for RoF communication. Comm signal upconverted to 28 GHz IF.

channel_wireless.notes: 10 km fiber (SSMF) + 10 m PZT at far end. 1 m wireless Ka-band link with phased array antennas.

comm_metrics.notes: 1.6 GBaud 16-QAM = 6.4 Gbps. 28 GHz Ka-band. BER below SD-FEC with PCS/pre-compensation. 10 km fiber + 1 m wireless demo.

sensing_metrics.notes: φ-OTDR with RVS algorithm. 50 MHz LFM → 10 m spatial resolution. 28 pε/√Hz strain sensitivity. Vibration: 50 Hz to 1 kHz verified.

tradeoff.notes: CSPR 10-16 dB analyzed. Lower CSPR = higher comm power but more nonlinearity. Sensing unaffected by CSPR changes.
